body: macOS end-to-end testing started 2026-09-27.U+000AU+000AOwner go-ahead this session: "Proceed with the MacOS test. ... ensure that if I need to take back control (i.e., Start using the trackpad and/or keyboard), I can and that my I/Os are NOT frozen." Keep-awake (caffeinate for the run, display sleep at the end) approved by the owner in this session.U+000AU+000ASetup M0:U+000AU+002D Scratch worktree at d36b748 (origin/feat/composer-editor-core, PRs through #211) in the session scratchpad `macprobe`, with macos-probe-native-input.patch and drive-sh-harness-fixes.patch applied cleanly. The main tree's drive.sh was not touched; its uncommitted diff is byte-identical to drive-sh-harness-fixes.patch.U+000AU+002D Profile probe built and copied to testkit/apps/profile/field_notes_probe.app (COMMIT d36b748). pinp, probe_guard and crop recompiled.U+000AU+002D The owner's real app container ~/Library/Containers/dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes exists (32 MB). The plain-app smoke (M15) must use a renamed bundle id so it never opens that data.U+000AU+002D Journey driving uses a new scratchpad driver (m.zsh + sem.py): arms only after 12 s of owner idle, starts a sentinel process and probe_guard (listen-only HID tap, aborts on any owner key, click, scroll or 24 px move), sends input only through the probe's in-app `input` endpoint (NSApp.postEvent to its own window) and refuses to send when the probe is not frontmost. Controls are located through the probe's `semantics` endpoint by label.U+000AU+002D The testkit's gate.zsh and run_all.zsh reference $L/drive_live.zsh and $L/overrides.zsh, but the files live under scripts/; those paths are stale if the gate scenarios are needed.
